name: Dinh Cau Night Market
kicker: Night market beside the rock temple
summary: Night market by Dinh Cậu: point at the catch and eat it from 5 pm until midnight. The streets by the rock temple close to traffic, with 100-odd stalls and more than half of them food. Bạch Đằng has a night market of 50-plus stalls. More than a hundred vendors also sell here. The three names mark separate streets.
getThere: The streets beside Dinh Cậu, in Dương Đông
heroCaption: The evening aisle at Chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, with stalls on both sides

notice.title: Three streets, three names
notice.body: The streets by Dinh Cậu run from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls. Bạch Đằng has 50-plus stalls and is pedestrian in the evening. Chợ đêm Dinh Cậu is a third name. Start at the temple gate, and ask for Bạch Đằng if you are on the wrong street.

body: Choose the catch and have it grilled. The streets near the Dinh Cậu rock temple close to traffic from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls and more than half of them food. You can also buy fish sauce, black pepper, myrtle wine, cashew nuts, dried seaweed, or squid. More than a hundred vendors sell twice that many seafood dishes. Grilled seafood, fruit, and snacks are at the Phu Quoc Night Market near Dương Đông.

One market is on Bạch Đằng in Dương Đông, pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls. Another name is chợ đêm Dinh Cậu. Dinner is also served at Dương Đông seafood market. Those names mark separate streets. Start at the Dinh Cậu gate after the sunset at the temple, and ask for Bạch Đằng if the street you are on is the wrong one.

figures.caption: A souvenir stall inside the Dinh Cậu night market
figures.alt: Beads, shells, and display cases at a stall in Dinh Cau Night Market

gettingThere: The market fills the streets beside the Dinh Cậu rock temple in Dương Đông. Phu Quoc Night Market is on Bạch Đằng. Walk from the temple after sunset, or ride in from a room on Bãi Trường.

legs.heading: From Dinh Cậu
legs.body: The streets near the rock temple close to traffic from 5 pm until midnight. The market is that pedestrian stretch.

legs.heading: From Bạch Đằng
legs.body: Phu Quoc Night Market is on Bạch Đằng, pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls.

admissionNote: The 5 pm until midnight window is for the streets near Dinh Cậu. Bạch Đằng is pedestrian in the evening, with 50-plus stalls.
